mods.name: MC Anti-Aliasing
mods.description: Several configurable anti-aliasing methods for Sodium. Project code is AI-generated with OpenAI Codex; SMAA includes third-party code and assets.

releases.notes:
Minecraft 26.3 port of MC Anti-Aliasing for Fabric and Sodium.

**AI-generated code:** the mod implementation and port were generated with OpenAI Codex under human direction. SMAA reference code and textures retain their upstream attribution and MIT license.

- Supports FXAA, SMAA 1x, and SMAA Ultra (Color), configured in Sodium's Anti-Aliasing page.
- Updates the renderer injection for Minecraft 26.3 and migrates shaders to the new include and SPIR-V compilation requirements.
- Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Sodium 0.9.2+ for 26.3, and Java 25.
- Built successfully and smoke-tested in a singleplayer world with all three modes on OpenGL. Vulkan and active Iris shader-pack switching have not been runtime-tested for this release.

Download the regular `.jar` and place it in the client's `mods` directory. The `-sources.jar` is for development only. Restart Minecraft after installation.
